title: Aoyagi Toya — Happy Birthday!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “The traveler that was once so lonely now has many friends and no longer has to feel alone. The end.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa, Kamishiro and you too, Kusanagi. Thank you for putting on such a wonderful show for us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was totally clean too.
No explosions, weird props or anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh? This is a school, you know?
We're not allowed to use anything that's considered dangerous or unusual.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know for a fact that you were going to if I didn't stop you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This was much easier to digest compared to that insane rendition of Romeo you guys did that other time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, this was a very moving story.
It was also fun seeing the traveler's circle of friends grow along the way.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa, thank you for coming up with such a wonderful show for me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anything becomes possible when I put my mind to something! Hah hah hah hah!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright. Ready, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An & Akito
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, let's cut the cake.
Which part would you like, Toya?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Every part should taste the same. I made sure to completely cover it with fruity toppings.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I know.
I was just trying to create the right mood.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, this part looks nice.
The one with the strawberries and blueberries on top.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: KAITO, can I have the one next to that?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I want the one on the other side!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm fine with whatever as long as I get to have some♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
You all realize it's Toya's birthday today, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't forget to have some sandwiches too, Toya. I helped make them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You did, Miku?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, um... They should be fine.
KAITO was there to make them with her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, MEIKO, what do you mean by “fine”?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Huh? Nothing serious.
Haha...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot. I brought something to share with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, cookies!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like some as well♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? There's only three left. What about you guys, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I already had some at school.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An and I had some when we celebrated at her dad's cafe earlier.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, okay. You already had a chance to celebrate. In that case, I think I'll take one.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That leaves two.
Just enough for the both of you, MEIKO, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, hold up...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Toya, have you had any for yourself?
You've been handing them out all day, but I don't think I've seen you eat a single one...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Akito, I get that Toya overlooks things sometimes, but that doesn't mean...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I don't think I have...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're kidding, right?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh no! Rin, Luka, stop! Stop!
Don't eat those cookies yet!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A-All good! I haven't touched mine yet!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Barely safe!
I was just about to eat it with some of the cake's whipped cream...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, on the other hand... I'd like you to all have them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It is true that I used to eat these all by myself whenever my mother made them for me...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But that was because I didn't have any friends to share them with.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, things are different now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have so many friends that I don't have enough cookies to go around.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If that's the case, I'll also be taking one!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
W-Wait, KAITO!
There won't be any left for Toya...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Don't worry!
Let's see... Right about here and... Crack!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Darn... It didn't split in half as nicely as I'd hoped. Anyway, Toya, you can have the bigger piece!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Now you both get to have a piece!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna try that too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Okay♪
If we split the remaining six in half, it'll be enough for three whole pieces!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. And Toya gets all the remaining halves, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. I mean, his mother made these just for him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay...
Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez... You're a smart guy, so don't forget to include yourself when it comes to stuff like this, okay?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hehe. My apologies.

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Toya!
You got to see Tsukasa's show at school today, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. He practiced it a ton too.
He seemed so determined to make sure you really enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course, I did. A star is no star unless they're giving everything they do all that they have!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's also wonderful to see how much you've been smiling lately, Toya. I believe it goes without saying that you should take good care of Akito and all your friends.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Toya!
And thanks for inviting me to see that special show. I had loads of fun♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You really took us by surprise when you left school right after feeling so satisfied too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm glad to see that you liked our special show, Aoyagi. It'd be great to have you play a role for us the next time we do something like this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Inviting him's fine, but don't make him do anything crazy, okay? It might make the split-personality guy mad.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But in any case... I'm glad you enjoyed our show and I'm glad I decided to help out.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Aoyagi!
The party we had in SEKAI was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I got so worried for a second when we realized that there weren't enough cookies to go around.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
At the same time, it was kinda nice.
Len and the others seemed to really enjoy it too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I guess it just means birthday parties are all about having tons of fun with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I agree! I hope we get to do this every year.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Same. Don't expect anything less, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting such a vibrant birthday celebration...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Cookies were all that I really used to have to mark this occasion. But now, I have my friends, my seniors from school, as well as Miku and the others.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I couldn't ask for a better birthday present.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I hope I get to celebrate my birthday again with everyone like this next year.
